_comment: timeline_gen.py build <lrc> spec.json -o TIMELINE.py | the worked spec of the reference case (《待春归》, 45 sung lines -> 55 pages). Copy and re-point every field.
_comment_keys: keys = one stable id per sung line, in LRC order; the renderer's content table is keyed by these, and a repeated phrase gets -2/-3 suffixes so the second appearance can be laid out differently. Omit 'keys' only if you do not want key-suffixing of repeats.
_comment_cards: cards = the arrangement decision, NOT a computed value: how many card pages go before which line (0 = before the first line / song head) and which group they belong to. A card group's span must be >= n * card_t and >= min_gap, and n pages share the span evenly.
